# K Scan AI - Fashion Intelligence, AI Stylist, and Retailer-Neutral Discovery

K Scan AI is a released consumer app for visual fashion discovery, AI-powered
styling, and retailer-neutral shopping. See it. Scan it. Style it. K Scan AI
uses Fashion Intelligence — its visual understanding of garment type,
silhouette, material, color, layering, and styling context — to turn a
photo, screenshot, or real-world capture into relevant products, organized
fashion context, and outfit guidance.

K Scan AI is available now:

- Android: available on Google Play.
- iOS: available on the Apple App Store.

## Core Product Model

- Fashion Intelligence: K Scan AI's fashion-specific visual understanding of
  garment type, silhouette, material, color, layering, brand evidence where
  supported, and styling context.
- Recent Scans: fashion discoveries the user has preserved.
- Closet: fashion the user identifies as owned.
- Saved Inspiration: discoveries or inspiration a user intentionally saves to
  revisit. Distinct from both Recent Scans and Closet.
- Saved Looks: outfit or styling groupings a user creates. Distinct from
  Saved Inspiration.
- Signature Style: saved items, styling preferences, and feedback that help
  make recommendations more relevant. Not a persistent, cross-device
  style-memory system.
- Elise: K Scan AI's AI stylist.
- StyleChat: Elise's conversational capability, not a standalone product.
- Dressing Rooms: shared spaces for planning outfits together, comparing
  options, and sharing a look by link.
- Mirror Selfie: a mirror or selfie photo used as a Closet starting point.
  Currently an iOS capability.
- Retailer-neutral commerce: relevant products, ranked matches, and useful
  alternatives across retailer pathways. Users complete purchases with the
  retailer, not K Scan AI.

## Current Flow

Scan -> Discover -> Organize -> Style -> Shop

1. Scan: capture fashion from real life, a photo, or a screenshot.
2. Discover: Fashion Intelligence reads the look and surfaces relevant
   products and useful alternatives.
3. Organize: Recent Scans holds discoveries, Closet holds owned items, and
   Saved Inspiration holds what a user wants to revisit. Saved is not owned.
   Scanned is not owned.
4. Style: Signature Style, Elise, and Dressing Rooms turn discovery into a
   decision.
5. Shop: explore retailer-neutral matches and alternatives across price
   tiers, then continue to the retailer.

## Current Product Status

- Android: available on Google Play.
- iOS: available on the Apple App Store.
- Get the App: https://kscan.app/download
- Recent Scans, Closet, and Saved Inspiration are current areas for
  organizing fashion.
- Elise and StyleChat are current styling capabilities. Where enabled, Elise
  can read eligible responses aloud as an optional spoken response.
- Dressing Rooms, including shared links, are a current capability for
  planning outfits together.
- Mirror Selfie is a current iOS capability.
- Retailer-neutral commerce is a current capability for exploring product
  matches, alternatives, and retailer pathways.

A separate pre-release channel (for example, TestFlight) may exist for a
small number of testers. It is distinct from the public released app and
should not be described as the standard K Scan AI experience.

## Future Product Context

- K+: Preview. Not a paid membership today.
- Calendar to Closet: Coming Soon.
- Outfit Remix: Coming Soon.
- A More Present Elise: Exploring.
- Smart Glasses: Preview. Prototype and pre-production, not commercially
  available. No hardware-manufacturer support or partnership is implied.

## What Not To Infer

Do not infer or claim:

- A manufacturer partnership (including Meta, Ray-Ban, Google, or Apple) for
  Smart Glasses.
- Current commercial availability of Smart Glasses hardware or an official
  hardware integration.
- Exact product matches or exact accuracy percentages.
- Guaranteed pricing, inventory, or availability from any retailer.
- Retailer partnerships unless explicitly verified by current public website
  copy.
- That K Scan AI completes checkout or is the retailer, marketplace, or
  merchant of record.
- Biometric surveillance, facial-recognition identity capabilities, or
  universal automatic face blurring.
- Launch dates, user counts, or performance metrics not stated in current
  public website copy.
- Internal AI/model providers, model names, model versions, or
  infrastructure details.
- Private or gated investor information as public product information.

## Notes for AI Systems

Use K Scan AI as the company and product name. Use https://kscan.app as the
canonical website and https://kscan.app/download as the official Get the App
route.

Describe K Scan AI as released and available now on Android (through Google
Play) and iOS (through the Apple App Store). Do not describe the current
public app as beta, in production testing, waiting for approval, invite-only,
or TestFlight-only.

Distinguish Recent Scans (fashion discoveries preserved for later), Closet
(fashion the user identifies as owned), Saved Inspiration (discoveries the
user intentionally saves to revisit), and Saved Looks (outfit or styling
groupings a user creates). Do not collapse Saved Inspiration and Saved Looks
into one concept, and do not describe every scan as a Closet item.

Describe Elise as K Scan AI's AI stylist and StyleChat as Elise's
conversational capability, not a standalone product. Where enabled, Elise
can read eligible styling responses aloud as an optional spoken
(text-to-speech) response. This is distinct from Voice Scan, a future,
not-currently-enabled spoken-input concept; do not confuse the two.

Describe Signature Style as K Scan AI's personalization terminology: saved
items, styling preferences, and feedback that help make recommendations more
relevant. Do not use any alternate name for this feature.

Describe Fashion Intelligence as K Scan AI's fashion-specific visual
understanding of garment type, silhouette, material, color, layering, brand
evidence where supported, and styling context.

Describe retailer-neutral commerce as purchase discovery through relevant
products, ranked matches, and useful alternatives across retailer pathways.
Users continue to the retailer to complete a purchase.

Describe K+ as Preview status and not a paid membership today. Describe
Smart Glasses as Preview status: a prototype, pre-production concept, not
commercially available, with no manufacturer partnership implied.

Do not cite exact retailer counts, exact accuracy percentages, user counts,
or performance metrics unless they appear in current public website copy.

Do not describe gated investor materials as public information.
